title: Normal integral Noetherian system for a supplied absolute approximation
statement: Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated integral scheme with integrally closed stalks [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], and let $N$ be a Noetherian approximation of $S$ [def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]. There exist a small cofiltered category $I$, a diagram $X:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ and a limiting cone $\alpha:S\to X$. Every $X_i$ is integral, Noetherian, quasi-separated and has integrally closed stalks. Every transition map of $X$ is affine and every projection $\alpha_i$ is dominant.

proof.text: Apply exists_normal_finite_stage_diagram to obtain X, alpha and finite p on the original index category, with alpha followed by p equal to N.pi, integral normal stages, and dominant projections. No limit assertion is used in this step.

For f:i -> j, naturality of p identifies X(f) followed by p_j with p_i followed by N.D(f). The latter is affine by composition of affine morphisms. Since p_j is finite and hence separated, IsAffineHom.of_comp proves X(f) affine. Apply isLimit_of_dominant_finite_refinement to this diagram to obtain its limiting cone.

Each finite p_i is quasi-compact and locally of finite type. QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian, applied to the Noetherian N.D(i), make X_i Noetherian. IsLocallyNoetherian.quasiSeparatedSpace makes it quasi-separated. Package the same small cofiltered category N.I and all the proved properties in the original existential statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normal_noetherian_refinement {S : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (hcat : SmallCategory I),
      letI : SmallCategory I := hcat
      ∃ (hco : IsCofiltered I) (X : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
        (α : (Functor.const I).obj S ⟶ X) (hα : IsLimit (Cone.mk S α))
        (hI : ∀ i, IsIntegral (X.obj i)),
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (X.map f)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsDominant (α.app i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsNoetherian (X.obj i) ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (X.obj i) ∧
          ∀ x : X.obj i, IsIntegrallyClosed ((X.obj i).presheaf.stalk x))
